cases.input: Two portfolios use the same approved criteria-set version with different candidate sets.
cases.expect: The set is reused without merging portfolios, candidates or prioritization releases.

cases.input: A later review changes weights while criterion semantics remain stable.
cases.expect: A successor version or separately pinned weighting release is created and old rankings remain reproducible.

cases.input: Two portfolios admit one initiative with shares 0.6 and 0.25, both with shareBasis capital, from distinct released sources.
cases.expect: Memberships and allocation intents remain independent; no completeness or exclusivity is inferred, and consolidated reporting derives no actual, capacity, outcome or benefit from the shares.

cases.input: A rank from one review is written as an intrinsic property of the initiative.
cases.expect: The write is rejected.

cases.input: Ranks using different criteria versions and price bases are compared directly.
cases.expect: The comparison is rejected.

cases.input: Observed metric values are stored as mutable properties of the criteria definition.
cases.expect: The ownership merge is rejected.

cases.input: The highest-ranked scenario becomes approved automatically.
cases.expect: The transition is rejected without authorized decision and issued baseline.

cases.input: Set S, version v2, status effective, cited by prioritization release PR-1 of portfolio PF-1; PF-1 is subsequently closed.
cases.expect: S/v2 remains resolvable at every knowledge time and its lifecycle state is unchanged by PF-1 closure.

cases.input: Set S records mastership as the governance body of portfolio PF-1.
cases.expect: Rejected; mastership must be an investment-methodology authority external to any portfolio.

cases.input: Prioritization release PR-1 pins set S version v2 and weighting scheme W version v1, each resolved independently.
cases.expect: PR-1 is accepted and both pins resolve without traversing any portfolio.

cases.input: Weights and a normalization rule are written as fields of set version S/v2.
cases.expect: Rejected; weighting is a separately identified and separately versioned scheme.

cases.input: Criterion C-1 in S/v2 declares measureRef, scale and unit but no preferenceDirection.
cases.expect: Rejected at set-version approval; the version cannot reach approved state.

cases.input: Criterion C-2 in S/v2 declares no criterionClass value from {mandatory, compensatory}.
cases.expect: Rejected at set-version approval.

cases.input: Set S is asserted effective while all of its versions are draft or superseded.
cases.expect: Rejected; effectivity is carried only by versions and a closed or version-less set holds none.

cases.input: S/v2 is superseded by S/v3; PR-1, decision D-7 and record REC-7 are replayed at the knowledge time preceding supersession.
cases.expect: PR-1, D-7 and REC-7 reproduce byte-identically against S/v2 with recordedAt and assertedFrom unchanged.

cases.input: PF-1 and PF-2 both pin S/v2 and W/v1 but cite different observationAuthorityRef values; their ranks for component INI-1 are compared on one scale.
cases.expect: Rejected; the comparability pin set is not identical.

cases.input: PF-1 ranks INI-1 first and PF-2 ranks INI-1 seventh, each in its own prioritization release.
cases.expect: Both releases stand; no reconciliation, precedence or merge is performed and no rank is written to the INI-1 master.

cases.input: One WM-ACT-029 instance asserts discriminator values Program and Portfolio simultaneously.
cases.expect: Rejected; exactly one enumerated value is permitted and a profile change is supersession with new identity.

cases.input: A Portfolio instance asserts an exclusive child set, rolls component actuals to portfolio level, and requires component relatedness.
cases.expect: Rejected on all three assertions by the profile disabling constraint.

cases.input: PF-1 allocates share 0.6 and PF-2 share 0.25 to component INI-1, both with shareBasis capital, from distinct released sources.
cases.expect: Both allocations are accepted; no completeness, exclusivity or residual third share is inferred.

cases.input: An InvestmentAllocation declares share 0.4 with no shareBasis value.
cases.expect: Rejected; no default basis is applied and the allocation cannot be released.

cases.input: Consolidated reporting computes PF-1's accounting actual for INI-1 as 0.6 of the component actual, and sums expected benefit across PF-1 and PF-2 shares.
cases.expect: Rejected; actuals, capacity, outcomes and benefits are never derived or apportioned from allocation shares.

cases.input: Allocations drawn on one released funding source and period exceed its released amount.
cases.expect: Not executable: the Funding Source referent is unallocated, so the case fails closed and asserts no funding-integrity outcome.

cases.input: PF-1 transitions to closed and the transition attempts to close component INI-1 and void its baseline and actuals.
cases.expect: Rejected; memberships end prospectively and the component master, lifecycle, baseline, actuals and evidence are untouched.

cases.input: INI-1 is cancelled on its own master after scenario SC-3 was selected and baselined.
cases.expect: Affected memberships end prospectively at the recorded effective instant, forward allocation intent terminates, and SC-3, D-7, REC-7 and the baseline release are unmutated.

cases.input: INI-1 splits into INI-1a and INI-1b and the existing 0.6 share is automatically carried to both successors.
cases.expect: Rejected; each successor master requires a new membership assertion and a newly declared share.

cases.input: INI-1 is re-mastered from WM-ACT-030 to WM-ACT-005 following authorization.
cases.expect: Prior memberships end prospectively, a new membership is asserted against the new master, and no released prioritization, allocation, scenario or baseline is rewritten.

cases.input: Decision D-7 approves scenario SC-3 and issues REC-7.
cases.expect: A distinct immutable composition-and-allocation baseline release is created referencing SC-3, D-7 and REC-7; SC-3 remains an unmodified hypothesis release and absorbs no decision body.

cases.input: A strategic-alignment contribution claim is written onto set version S/v2 and onto the INI-1 master.
cases.expect: Rejected on both writes; the claim is owned by the prioritization release and references WM-KNW-011 without asserting causal or realized benefit.

cases.input: PF-1 holds three mutually unrelated components with no dependency, shared outcome or benefit hypothesis.
cases.expect: PF-1 remains a Portfolio profile; no Program is formed, inferred or required.

cases.input: An authorized rebalance follows a funding change after SC-3 was baselined.
cases.expect: Successor prioritization, allocation, scenario and baseline releases are issued; SC-3, D-7, REC-7 and the prior baseline remain immutable and resolvable.

cases.input: The profile is asserted conformant, installable or publication-ready while one or more entries in basePins carry pinState unverified.
cases.expect: Rejected; unverified base pins support no conformance, installability or publication claim.
